title: Board Switcher UI
description: A UI control (dropdown or list) to switch between boards, create a new board, and trigger rename/delete of the active board.
spec:
1. Render a switcher listing all boards with the active one indicated
2. Selecting a board makes it active and re-renders the board view
3. Provide an affordance to create a new board from the switcher
4. Provide affordances to rename and delete the active board
5. Verify the switcher stays in sync after create/rename/delete
